head: codex/5358-v0918-csdlc-v2-acceptance-prep
title: [v0.91.8][WP-14] Fully accept and deploy C-SDLC v2
body:
Closes #5358

Completes C-SDLC v2 acceptance and repairs the publication lifecycle so ready-PR reconciliation is exact, fail-closed, and recoverable. The implementation validates remote open state, repository and head identity, exact branch and revision, and supports recovery after a remote ready transition succeeds before local typed state commits.

The command-level HTTP matrix covers success and mismatch paths. Focused lifecycle tests pass 21/21, the complete csdlc-v2 all-target suite passes, strict all-target Clippy and formatting pass, typed doctor passes, and exact-revision DeepSeek review returned no findings. No AWS or raw gh was used.
